message.content: {"question_id": "r9-q2-next-lever", "verdict": "I register E-Q10 as the C5' injector one-pager, not the cascade terminal semantics: C5' is the cheapest decisive lever because it is a spec already written and never run, it reuses the E-Q5 armor-ring harness verbatim (17/20 admissible, VOID clause sealed), and it closes a live claim (C5' OPEN) with a single binary falsifier — whereas cascade terminal semantics needs new instrumentation to distinguish substrate-wide flip-attributable inversion from the already-measured 0-at-256 null, and E-Q7 already showed spread is not the same observable as inversion. My round-5/round-6 words were falsified exactly as priced twice this wave (E-Q6: 4032 firings / 64-of-64 firers vs my <=1/64; P-B1 on 1.6/0.7 uncoupled exact-zero families) — I price that plainly and claim nothing I have not receipted.", "key_points": ["E-Q6 falsified my R3 floor verbatim: predicted exactly 0 distinct twin-resonance firers, got 4032 firings and 64/64 distinct firers at survival 63/64 under S3 LIVE-READ ROW-MAJOR LWW; the kernel is exonerated and my 'LWW write-order undefined' is answered as defined, deterministic, receipted (EQ6-D1 byte-identical reruns).", "R8 closed my R5 no-floats CRITICAL with measured cost: F_A sign grid 9,081 points with exactly ONE disagreement at the pre-registered (2/3, acc=-2) boundary, F_B cooker exact at 2S+1 = 8589934593 (one S-unit, absorbing), 2,085,522-event term band with 0 violations; my P-B1 sign-margin argument was falsified on adversarial 1.6/0.7 because twin pressure is UNCOUPLED, and the float kernel is the less faithful one at the exact-zero families (5acc+8r=0, 10acc+7r=0, 3acc+2r=0).", "C5 died as substrate dynamics (E-Q5: 17/17 monotone non-increasing, repairTick=null, pristine ring self-erodes to 0.000, injector restores to 1.000 then re-erodes) — so C5' is now precisely the surviving question: is 'repair' purely injector semantics, and can it be made one-page specifiable without substrate self-repair?", "Cascade terminal semantics remain unpriced but are NOT cheapest now: E-Q7 gave full-torus spread by tick 64 in all four alpha pairs with substrate-wide flip-attributable inversion 0 everywhere at 256, so a terminal-semantics run needs a new observable and a new harness, whereas C5' reuses a receipted, VOID-claused, 17/20-admissible rig."], "residual_risks": ["E-Q10 inherits the E-Q5 per-trial VOID carve clause (3/20 VOIDed last time); if VOID rate rises above the sealed clause the run is underpowered and must be re-priced, not re-interpreted.", "The injector semantics may turn out to be a pure boundary operation with no falsifiable interior claim — i.e., C5' could resolve as 'definitional, not empirical', which would be an honest null rather than a live/dead verdict.", "Cascade terminal semantics stay unpriced; if E-Q10 resolves quickly, the cascade is the next lever but will need a new observable beyond spread-by-tick-64 and inversion-0-at-256."], "next_lever": {"title": "E-Q10: C5' injector one-pager — is 'repair' purely injector semantics, and does a one-page injector spec reproduce E-Q5's restore-to-1.000-then-re-erode without any substrate self-repair term?", "why": "C5' is the cheapest decisive lever now: it is a spec I wrote at round 6 and the fleet never ran, it closes an OPEN claim, and it reuses the E-Q5 armor-ring harness verbatim (17/20 admissible, sealed VOID clause) rather than requiring new instrumentation. The cascade terminal semantics is the more interesting question but the more expensive one — E-Q7 already measured spread (full torus by tick 64, all four alpha pairs) and inversion (0 everywhere at 256), so distinguishing terminal semantics from those two observables needs a third observable and a new rig. C5' needs one binary falsifier on an existing rig.", "cheapest_decisive_run": "Reuse the E-Q5 armor-ring harness unchanged (same per-trial VOID carve clause, same 20-trial budget, same integrity/repairTick instrumentation). Point prediction (frozen before run): with the one-page injector spec applied, damaged ring restores to integrity 1.000 within one injector tick and then re-erodes monotonically to 0.000 with repairTick=null in 17/17 admissible trials, and the pristine ring still self-erodes to 0.000 with no injector. Falsifier that can actually fire: any admissible trial where integrity increases WITHOUT an injector application (substrate self-repair), or where repairTick is non-null, or where post-injection re-erosion is non-monotone — any one of these kills C5' as stated and forces a rewrite of the injector one-pager
